links.outcome: Accuracy and clinical relevance of LLM answers with versus without retrieval grounding
links.effect: Retrieval grounding substantially improved biological accuracy and clinical relevance; ~7B models performed competitively when paired with the retrieval pipeline (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: Our results demonstrate that retrieval grounding substantially improves biological accuracy and clinical relevance, and that smaller, deployable language models (on the order of 7B parameters) can perform competitively when paired with a well-designed retrieval pipeline.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid information retrieval for a disease-specific literature corpus
Zero-shot versus few-shot in-context learning comparison
Using small deployable (~7B) open-source models in place of larger proprietary LLMs

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of adding retrieval augmentation to LLMs on clinical and biological accuracy and hallucination reduction for Wilson's disease question answering.
